metadata.description: Compliance controls reference for SOC 2 (2017 TSC, 2022 revised points of focus), ISO 27001:2022 (Annex A, 93 controls), and PCI DSS v4.0.1 (12 requirements). Use this as a baked-in reference when building compliance-aware applications.

sources.soc2: AICPA Trust Services Criteria 2017 with 2022 Revised Points of Focus
sources.iso27001: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A (93 controls across 4 themes)
sources.pci_dss: PCI DSS v4.0.1 (active as of January 2025 — the only active version)

SOC2.description: SOC 2 evaluates service organizations against up to five Trust Services Criteria. Security (Common Criteria CC1–CC9) is mandatory; the other four are optional based on business commitments.

categories.name: Security — Common Criteria
categories.description: The foundational criteria required for every SOC 2 audit. Maps to the COSO framework.

criteria.name: Control Environment
criteria.objective: Establishes the foundation for internal control through integrity, ethical values, and governance.

sub_criteria.description: Demonstrates commitment to integrity and ethical values.
Board of directors demonstrates independence from management and oversees internal controls.
Management establishes structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities to pursue objectives.
Demonstrates commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals.
Holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities.

criteria.name: Communication and Information
criteria.objective: Ensures relevant, quality information is identified, captured, and communicated in a timely manner.

sub_criteria.description: Uses relevant, quality information to support functioning of other components of internal control.
Internally communicates information necessary to support the functioning of internal control.
Communicates with external parties regarding matters affecting the functioning of other components of internal control.

criteria.name: Risk Assessment
criteria.objective: Identifies and analyzes risks to achieving objectives, and determines how risks should be managed.

sub_criteria.description: Specifies objectives clearly enough to enable identification and assessment of related risks.
Identifies and analyzes risks to achieving objectives, forming a basis for determining how risks should be managed.
Considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks to the achievement of objectives.
Identifies and assesses changes that could significantly affect the system of internal control.

criteria.name: Monitoring Activities
criteria.objective: Selects, develops, and performs ongoing evaluations to ascertain whether the components of internal control are present and functioning.

sub_criteria.description: Selects, develops, and performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations to ascertain whether controls are present and functioning.
Evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies in a timely manner to those responsible for taking corrective action.

criteria.name: Control Activities
criteria.objective: Selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks and deploys them through policies.

sub_criteria.description: Selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives.
Selects and develops general controls over technology to support the achievement of objectives.
Deploys control activities through policies that establish expectations and procedures that put policies into action.

criteria.name: Logical and Physical Access Controls
criteria.objective: Implements logical access controls and physical access controls to prevent unauthorized access.

sub_criteria.description: Implements logical access security measures to authorized information assets, including authentication, authorization, network segmentation, and encryption.
Registers and authorizes new internal and external users prior to granting access. Removes credentials when no longer authorized.
Removes access when no longer needed; reviews access periodically.
Restricts physical access to facilities and protected information assets.
Logically or physically removes and disposes of sensitive information assets when no longer needed.
Implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software.
Restricts transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized internal and external users.
Implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software.

criteria.name: System Operations
criteria.objective: Detects and monitors for new vulnerabilities, manages operational incidents, and recovers from identified security events.

sub_criteria.description: Detects and monitors for new vulnerabilities and evaluates the severity of, and develops mitigations for, identified vulnerabilities.
Monitors system components for anomalous behavior that might indicate malicious acts, natural disasters, and errors.
Evaluates security events to determine whether they could or have resulted in a failure of the system to meet objectives.
Responds to identified security incidents by executing a defined incident response program.
Identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from identified security incidents.

criteria.name: Change Management
criteria.objective: Manages changes to system components to prevent unauthorized changes and ensure integrity.

sub_criteria.description: Authorizes, designs, develops, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures.

criteria.name: Risk Mitigation
criteria.objective: Identifies and mitigates risks from business disruptions and vendor/business partner management.

sub_criteria.description: Identifies and mitigates risks associated with business disruptions (e.g., availability commitments and system requirements).
Assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners, including due diligence, contractual requirements, and ongoing monitoring.

categories.name: Availability
categories.description: Optional. Applies when uptime, resilience, and disaster recovery commitments are made to customers.

criteria.description: Uses current processing capacity and performance requirements, including the existence of performance commitments in customer agreements.
Provides data backup, recovery, and business continuity plans to meet its availability commitments and system requirements.
Tests recovery plan procedures for disaster recovery scenarios to meet its availability commitments and system requirements.

categories.name: Processing Integrity
categories.description: Optional. Applies when the service processes transactions or data and accuracy, completeness, and timeliness are part of the commitment.

criteria.description: Obtains or generates, uses, and communicates relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control.
Implements point-of-entry validations to ensure that inputs (data and instructions) are complete, accurate, and authorized.
Implements procedures to detect processing errors and correct them on a timely basis.
Implements procedures to ensure that outputs of the system are complete, accurate, and distributed to authorized parties.
Stores inputs, items in processing, and outputs completely and accurately in accordance with system commitments and requirements.

categories.name: Confidentiality
categories.description: Optional. Applies when the service stores or transmits sensitive non-public business information.

criteria.description: Identifies and maintains confidential information to meet the entity's objectives related to confidentiality.
Disposes of confidential information to meet the entity's objectives related to confidentiality.

categories.name: Privacy
categories.description: Optional. Applies when the service collects, uses, stores, discloses, or disposes of personal information (PII).

criteria.name: Notice and Communication of Objectives
criteria.description: Entity provides notice about its privacy objectives and practices.

criteria.name: Choice and Consent
criteria.description: Entity communicates choices available to individuals regarding collection, use, and disclosure of personal information.

criteria.name: Collection
criteria.description: Personal information collected limited to that which is necessary for the purposes identified in the entity's privacy notice.

criteria.name: Use, Retention, and Disposal
criteria.description: Personal information used consistently with privacy notice and not retained longer than necessary.

criteria.name: Access
criteria.description: Entity provides individuals with access to their personal information for review and update.

criteria.name: Disclosure and Notification
criteria.description: Entity discloses personal information to third parties only in accordance with privacy notice objectives.

criteria.name: Quality
criteria.description: Entity collects and maintains accurate, up-to-date, complete, and relevant personal information.

criteria.name: Monitoring and Enforcement
criteria.description: Entity monitors compliance with its privacy commitments and addresses privacy-related inquiries, complaints, and disputes.

ISO_27001_2022.description: International standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS). Annex A contains 93 controls across 4 themes: Organizational (5.x), People (6.x), Physical (7.x), and Technological (8.x).

controls.name: Policies for information security
controls.description: Define, approve, publish, and review information security policies.

controls.name: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Assign and communicate information security responsibilities across the organization.

controls.name: Segregation of duties
controls.description: Separate conflicting duties to reduce opportunities for unauthorized modification, misuse, or misappropriation of assets.

controls.name: Management responsibilities
controls.description: Require management to apply information security in accordance with established policies.

controls.name: Contact with authorities
controls.description: Maintain appropriate contacts with relevant authorities.

controls.name: Contact with special interest groups
controls.description: Maintain contact with security forums and professional associations.

controls.name: Threat intelligence
controls.description: NEW (2022). Collect and analyze information relating to information security threats to produce actionable threat intelligence.

controls.name: Information security in project management
controls.description: Integrate information security into project management.

controls.name: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Identify and maintain an inventory of information assets and associated assets.

controls.name: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Define rules for acceptable use and handling of information and associated assets.

controls.name: Return of assets
controls.description: Personnel and external party users return all assets upon change or termination of employment.

controls.name: Classification of information
controls.description: Classify information according to the organization's security requirements.

controls.name: Labelling of information
controls.description: Develop and implement procedures for labelling information per the classification scheme.

controls.name: Information transfer
controls.description: Apply transfer policies, procedures, and agreements for all types of transfer facilities.

controls.name: Access control
controls.description: Establish, document, and review rules for access to information and assets.

controls.name: Identity management
controls.description: Manage the full lifecycle of identities.

controls.name: Authentication information
controls.description: Control the allocation and management of authentication information.

controls.name: Access rights
controls.description: Provision, review, modify, and remove access rights.

controls.name: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.description: Define and implement processes to manage information security risks in supplier relationships.

controls.name: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.description: Establish and agree on relevant information security requirements with each supplier.

controls.name: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.description: Manage ICT product and service security risks in the supply chain.

controls.name: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.description: Regularly monitor, review, evaluate, and manage changes to supplier information security practices.

controls.name: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.description: NEW (2022). Establish processes for acquisition, use, management, and exit of cloud services.

controls.name: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.description: Plan and prepare for incident management, defining roles and response procedures.

controls.name: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.description: Assess information security events and decide if they are to be classified as incidents.

controls.name: Response to information security incidents
controls.description: Respond to information security incidents in accordance with documented procedures.

controls.name: Learning from information security incidents
controls.description: Use knowledge gained from incidents to strengthen controls.

controls.name: Collection of evidence
controls.description: Establish and implement procedures for identification, collection, and preservation of evidence.

controls.name: Information security during disruption
controls.description: Maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.

controls.name: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.description: NEW (2022). Plan, implement, maintain, and test ICT readiness based on business continuity objectives.

controls.name: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.description: Identify, document, and keep up-to-date all legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements.

controls.name: Intellectual property rights
controls.description: Implement procedures to protect intellectual property rights.

controls.name: Protection of records
controls.description: Protect records from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access, and unauthorized release.

controls.name: Privacy and protection of personal information (PII)
controls.description: Identify and meet data privacy and protection requirements.

controls.name: Independent review of information security
controls.description: Review approach to managing information security at planned intervals or significant changes.

controls.name: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
controls.description: Regularly review compliance with security policies, standards, and procedures.

controls.name: Documented operating procedures
controls.description: Document operating procedures for information processing facilities and make available to personnel.

controls.name: Screening
controls.description: Verify the background of all candidates prior to joining and on an ongoing basis.

controls.name: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: Employment contracts state employees' and the organization's information security responsibilities.

controls.name: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: Ensure all personnel receive relevant awareness education, training, and updates to security policies.

controls.name: Disciplinary process
controls.description: Formalize and communicate a disciplinary process for personnel who have committed an information security policy violation.

controls.name: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.description: Define and enforce information security responsibilities upon termination or change of employment.

controls.name: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.description: Identify, document, and regularly review requirements for confidentiality or NDAs.

controls.name: Remote working
controls.description: Implement security measures when working remotely.

controls.name: Information security event reporting
controls.description: Provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected security events.

controls.name: Physical security perimeters
controls.description: Define and use security perimeters to protect areas that contain information and associated assets.

controls.name: Physical entry
controls.description: Secure areas are protected by appropriate entry controls to ensure only authorized personnel are allowed access.

controls.name: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.description: Design and apply physical security to offices, rooms, and facilities.

controls.name: Physical security monitoring
controls.description: NEW (2022). Continuously monitor premises for unauthorized physical access.

controls.name: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.description: Design and apply protection against physical and environmental threats.

controls.name: Working in secure areas
controls.description: Design and apply security measures for working in secure areas.

controls.name: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.description: Define and enforce clear desk and clear screen rules.

controls.name: Equipment siting and protection
controls.description: Locate and protect equipment to reduce risks from environmental threats and unauthorized access.

controls.name: Security of assets off-premises
controls.description: Apply security measures to assets used outside the organization's premises.

controls.name: Storage media
controls.description: Manage storage media lifecycle: acquisition, use, transportation, and disposal.

controls.name: Supporting utilities
controls.description: Protect information processing facilities from power and other utility failures.

controls.name: Cabling security
controls.description: Protect cables carrying power and data from interception, interference, or damage.

controls.name: Equipment maintenance
controls.description: Maintain equipment correctly to ensure availability, integrity, and confidentiality.

controls.name: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.description: Verify that sensitive data and licensed software has been removed before disposal or re-use.

controls.name: User endpoint devices
controls.description: Protect information stored on, processed on, or accessible via user endpoint devices.

controls.name: Privileged access rights
controls.description: Restrict and manage privileged access rights.

controls.name: Information access restriction
controls.description: Restrict access to information and application functions in accordance with the access control policy.

controls.name: Access to source code
controls.description: Manage read/write access to source code, development tools, and software libraries.

controls.name: Secure authentication
controls.description: Implement secure authentication technologies and procedures.

controls.name: Capacity management
controls.description: Monitor and adjust the use of resources in line with current and expected capacity needs.

controls.name: Protection against malware
controls.description: Implement protection against malware and apply user awareness.

controls.name: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Obtain timely information about vulnerabilities, evaluate exposure, and take appropriate action.

controls.name: Configuration management
controls.description: NEW (2022). Establish, document, implement, monitor, and review configurations including security configurations.

controls.name: Information deletion
controls.description: NEW (2022). Delete information when no longer required.

controls.name: Data masking
controls.description: NEW (2022). Use data masking in accordance with access control and business requirements.

controls.name: Data leakage prevention
controls.description: NEW (2022). Apply data leakage prevention measures to systems, networks, and devices.

controls.name: Information backup
controls.description: Maintain and regularly test backup copies of information, software, and systems.

controls.name: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.description: Implement sufficient redundancy to meet availability requirements.

controls.name: Logging
controls.description: Produce, store, protect, and analyze logs of activities, exceptions, faults, and events.

controls.name: Monitoring activities
controls.description: NEW (2022). Monitor networks, systems, and applications for anomalous behavior and take action.

controls.name: Clock synchronization
controls.description: Synchronize the clocks of information processing systems to approved time sources.

controls.name: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: Restrict and tightly control the use of utility programs that might override system or application controls.

controls.name: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Implement procedures to control software installation on operational systems.

controls.name: Networks security
controls.description: Secure, manage, and control networks to protect information in systems and applications.

controls.name: Security of network services
controls.description: Identify, implement, and monitor security mechanisms for all network services.

controls.name: Segregation of networks
controls.description: Segregate groups of information services, users, and information systems in networks.

controls.name: Web filtering
controls.description: NEW (2022). Manage access to external websites to reduce exposure to malicious content.

controls.name: Use of cryptography
controls.description: Define and implement rules for the effective use of cryptography, including key management.

controls.name: Secure development lifecycle
controls.description: Establish and apply rules for the secure development of software and systems.

controls.name: Application security requirements
controls.description: Identify, specify, and approve information security requirements when developing or acquiring applications.

controls.name: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.description: Establish, document, maintain, and apply security engineering principles for any engineering activity.

controls.name: Secure coding
controls.description: NEW (2022). Apply secure coding principles to software development.

controls.name: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.description: Define and implement security testing processes in the development lifecycle.

controls.name: Outsourced development
controls.description: Direct, monitor, and review activities related to outsourced system development.

controls.name: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.description: Separate development, testing, and production environments to prevent unauthorized access.

controls.name: Change management
controls.description: Subject changes to information processing facilities and systems to change management procedures.

controls.name: Test information
controls.description: Select, protect, and manage test information appropriately.

controls.name: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.description: Plan and agree audit tests that involve assessments of operational systems to minimize disruption.

PCI_DSS_v4_0_1.note: PCI DSS v4.0.1 is the only active version as of January 2025. All 64 new requirements (including the 51 formerly best-practice) were fully mandatory as of March 31, 2025.
PCI_DSS_v4_0_1.description: The Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard. Applies to any entity that stores, processes, or transmits cardholder data. Structured as 12 requirements under 6 security goals.

goals.goal: Build and Maintain a Secure Network and Systems

requirements.name: Install and Maintain Network Security Controls
requirements.objective: Protect the cardholder data environment (CDE) from unauthorized network access.
key_controls: 1.1 — Processes for managing network security controls are defined and understood.
1.2 — Network security controls configured to restrict inbound/outbound traffic to what is necessary.
1.3 — Restrict inbound and outbound traffic to only what is necessary in the CDE.
1.4 — Network access between trusted and untrusted networks is controlled.
1.5 — Risks from computing devices connecting to untrusted networks are managed.
requirements.v4_changes: Broadened scope from 'firewalls and routers' to 'network security controls' to include modern security technologies. Organizations must document and assign roles/responsibilities for network management.

requirements.name: Apply Secure Configurations to All System Components
requirements.objective: Prevent exploitation of vendor default accounts, passwords, and other configuration weaknesses.
key_controls: 2.1 — Processes for managing default security settings are defined and understood.
2.2 — System components configured and managed securely.
2.3 — Wireless environments configured and managed securely.
requirements.v4_changes: Expanded to address all system components, not just vendor defaults. Requires documented configuration standards and evidence of hardening.

requirements.name: Protect Stored Account Data
requirements.objective: Protect stored account data through encryption, masking, and strict retention policies.
key_controls: 3.1 — Processes for protecting stored account data are defined and understood.
3.2 — Storage of sensitive account data (SAD) is kept to the minimum necessary.
3.3 — SAD is not retained after authorization.
3.4 — Primary Account Numbers (PAN) are secured wherever stored.
3.5 — PAN is secured with strong cryptography wherever it is stored.
3.6 — Cryptographic keys used to protect stored account data are secured.
3.7 — Data protection methods and procedures are reviewed and updated.
requirements.v4_changes: Clarifications on SAD storage, keyed cryptographic hashes to render PAN unreadable, and stronger key management requirements.

requirements.name: Protect Cardholder Data with Strong Cryptography During Transmission Over Open, Public Networks
requirements.objective: Prevent interception of cardholder data in transit.
key_controls: 4.1 — Processes for protecting cardholder data in transit are defined and understood.
4.2 — PAN is protected with strong cryptography during transmission.
requirements.v4_changes: Clarified that all transmission paths (including web, API, and internal) must use strong cryptography. Deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1.

requirements.name: Protect All Systems and Networks from Malicious Software
requirements.objective: Deploy and maintain anti-malware solutions across all applicable systems.
key_controls: 5.1 — Processes for protecting against malware are defined and understood.
5.2 — Malware protection mechanisms are deployed and maintained on all applicable systems.
5.3 — Anti-malware mechanisms and their logs are protected from tampering.
5.4 — Phishing attacks are addressed.
requirements.v4_changes: Expanded to cover all applicable systems. Added a new control requiring anti-phishing mechanisms.

requirements.name: Develop and Maintain Secure Systems and Software
requirements.objective: Prevent exploitation of vulnerabilities in systems and software.
key_controls: 6.1 — Processes for developing and maintaining security are defined and understood.
6.2 — Bespoke and custom software is developed securely.
6.3 — Security vulnerabilities are identified and addressed.
6.4 — Public-facing web applications are protected against attacks.
6.5 — Changes to payment pages are managed securely.
6.6 — Deployed software is protected from attacks.
requirements.v4_changes: Requirement 6 now covers all software involved in payment processes, not just internally-developed applications. Adds eCommerce skimming attack prevention (6.4.3 and 6.5).

requirements.name: Restrict Access to System Components and Cardholder Data by Business Need to Know
requirements.objective: Ensure only authorized personnel can access cardholder data.
key_controls: 7.1 — Processes for restricting access to system components and cardholder data are defined and understood.
7.2 — Access to system components and cardholder data is appropriately defined and assigned.
7.3 — Access for all users is managed via an access control system.
requirements.v4_changes: Mandates clearly defined roles/responsibilities and regular access reviews. Principle of least privilege enforced with role-based access controls.

requirements.name: Identify Users and Authenticate Access to System Components
requirements.objective: Ensure each individual with access is uniquely identified and authenticated.
key_controls: 8.1 — Processes for identifying users and authenticating access are defined and understood.
8.2 — All users are assigned a unique ID before access is granted.
8.3 — User authentication is managed via strong mechanisms.
8.4 — MFA is implemented for access into the CDE.
8.5 — MFA systems are configured securely.
8.6 — Use of application and system accounts is managed.
requirements.v4_changes: Minimum password length increased from 7 to 12 characters. MFA required for all CDE access. Phishing-resistant MFA factors clarified in v4.0.1.

requirements.name: Restrict Physical Access to Cardholder Data
requirements.objective: Prevent unauthorized physical access to cardholder data and related systems.
key_controls: 9.1 — Processes for restricting physical access to cardholder data are defined and understood.
9.2 — Physical access controls manage entry into areas containing cardholder data.
9.3 — Physical access for personnel and visitors is authorized and managed.
9.4 — Media with cardholder data is securely stored, accessed, distributed, and destroyed.
9.5 — Point-of-interaction (POI) devices are protected from tampering and substitution.
requirements.v4_changes: Stronger focus on media destruction and POI device inspection processes.

requirements.name: Log and Monitor All Access to System Components and Cardholder Data
requirements.objective: Detect and investigate suspicious or anomalous activity through logging and monitoring.
key_controls: 10.1 — Processes for logging and monitoring are defined and understood.
10.2 — Audit logs capture all individual user access and actions.
10.3 — Audit logs are protected from unauthorized modification or destruction.
10.4 — Audit logs are reviewed to identify anomalies or suspicious activity.
10.5 — Retain audit log history for at least 12 months.
10.6 — Time synchronization is in place for all system components.
10.7 — Failures of critical security controls are detected, reported, and responded to promptly.
requirements.v4_changes: Added requirement to detect and respond to failures of critical security controls. Enhanced requirements for automated mechanisms to review logs.

requirements.name: Test Security of Systems and Networks Regularly
requirements.objective: Proactively identify and remediate vulnerabilities through regular testing.
key_controls: 11.1 — Processes for testing security of systems and networks are defined and understood.
11.2 — Wireless access points are identified and monitored. Rogue APs detected and addressed.
11.3 — External and internal vulnerabilities are regularly identified, prioritized, and addressed.
11.4 — External and internal penetration tests are performed regularly.
11.5 — Network intrusions and unexpected file changes are detected and responded to.
11.6 — Unauthorized changes on payment pages are detected and responded to.
requirements.v4_changes: Added 11.6 for change- and tamper-detection mechanisms on payment pages (anti-skimming).

requirements.name: Support Information Security with Organizational Policies and Programs
requirements.objective: Establish and maintain an organizational security policy, risk management, and incident response.
key_controls: 12.1 — An information security policy is established, published, maintained, and communicated.
12.2 — Acceptable use policies for end-user technologies are in place.
12.3 — Risks to the CDE are identified, evaluated, and managed.
12.4 — PCI DSS compliance is managed (service providers only: quarterly executive sign-off).
12.5 — PCI DSS scope is documented and confirmed at least annually.
12.6 — Security awareness education program is implemented.
12.7 — Personnel are screened before hiring to minimize insider threats.
12.8 — Third-party service provider (TPSP) risk is managed.
12.9 — TPSPs support customers' PCI DSS compliance efforts.
12.10 — Incidents and security breaches are responded to immediately.
requirements.v4_changes: 12.5.2 requires scope documentation and confirmation at least every 12 months. Updated TPSP relationship guidance (12.8, 12.9) clarified in v4.0.1. Stronger incident response testing requirements.

cross_framework_mapping.description: High-level mapping of common control domains across SOC 2, ISO 27001:2022, and PCI DSS v4.0.1 to aid implementation overlap analysis.
